description: This Java test class 'AllergyValidatorTest' contains unit tests for the 'AllergyValidator' class in the OpenMRS project, focusing on validation logic for allergy entities including checking for nulls, duplicates, and proper allergen data.

classes.name: AllergyValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of 'AllergyValidator' in various scenarios such as null inputs, duplicate allergens, and reaction validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailForANullValue
methods.description: Checks that the validator throws an exception when null is passed.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the allergy has no patient associated.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAllergenIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the allergen is not set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIdAllergenTypeIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the allergen type is not set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfCodedAndNonCodedAllergenAreNull
methods.description: Checks validation when both coded and non-coded allergen info are missing.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNonCodedAllergenIsNullAndAllergenIsSetToOtherNonCoded
methods.description: Validates that non-coded allergen info must be provided when allergen is non-coded.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectADuplicateAllergen
methods.description: Ensures that duplicate allergen entries are rejected.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectADuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Ensures duplicate non-coded allergens are rejected.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAValidAllergy
methods.description: Checks that a properly formed allergy passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectNumericReactionValue
methods.description: Verifies that reactions with numeric non-coded values are rejected.
